name: Ring of Jumping (improved)
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 172, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 172, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Aura moderate transmutation CL 7th
Slot ring; Price 10,000 gp; Weight —
Description
This ring functions as a ring of jumping, except it grants the wearer a +10 competence bonus all her Acrobatics checks made to make high or long jumps.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, creator must have 10 ranks in Acrobatics; Cost 5,000 gp
